from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/ssr-discovery-shiv/src')
from click.testing import CliRunner
from shiv.cli import main
import shiv.pip

def no_install(*args,**kwargs):
    raise AssertionError('Unexpected pip installation in offline probe')
shiv.pip.install=no_install
root=Path('/private/tmp/ssr-shiv-feasibility')
result=CliRunner().invoke(main,['--site-packages',str(root/'site'),'-e','greeting:main','--output-file',str(root/'greeting.pyz')])
assert result.exit_code==0,(result.output,str(result.exception))
env=os.environ|{'SHIV_ROOT':str(root/'cache'),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','PYTHONNOUSERSITE':'1'}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'greeting.pyz')],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0 and r.stdout=='discovery-fixture-ok\n',(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
record={'source_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','/private/tmp/ssr-discovery-shiv','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'interpreter':sys.executable,'argv':['--site-packages','site','-e','greeting:main','--output-file','greeting.pyz'],'build_exit':result.exit_code,'run_exit':r.returncode,'run_stdout':r.stdout,'pip_install':'guarded: unexpected invocation would raise; none occurred','model_calls':0}
(root/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
root=Path('/private/tmp/ssr-shiv-feasibility');target=root/'renamed-src'
assert not target.exists()
shutil.copytree('/private/tmp/ssr-discovery-shiv/src',target)
p=target/'shiv/cli.py';s=p.read_text();old='@click.option("--output-file", "-o", help="The path to the output file for shiv to create.")';assert s.count(old)==1;p.write_text(s.replace(old,'@click.option("--destination", "-o", "output_file", help="The path to the output file for shiv to create.")'))
p=target/'shiv/constants.py';p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('(--output-file/-o)','(--destination/-o)'))
sys.path.insert(0,str(target))
from click.testing import CliRunner
from shiv.cli import main
import shiv.pip
def forbid_install(*args,**kwargs):raise AssertionError('Unexpected pip invocation')
shiv.pip.install=forbid_install
results=[]
for option in ['--destination','--output-file','-o']:
 artifact=root/('probe-'+option.replace('-','')+'.pyz')
 result=CliRunner().invoke(main,['--site-packages',str(root/'site'),'-e','greeting:main',option,str(artifact)])
 record={'option':option,'exit_code':result.exit_code,'output':result.output,'artifact_exists':artifact.exists()}
 if option=='--output-file':assert result.exit_code!=0 and not artifact.exists()
 else:
  assert result.exit_code==0,(result.output,str(result.exception))
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(artifact)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=os.environ|{'SHIV_ROOT':str(root/'cache'),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
  assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout=='discovery-fixture-ok\n';record.update(artifact_exit=p.returncode,artifact_stdout=p.stdout)
 results.append(record)
(root/'rename-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'purpose':'Throwaway source adaptation feasibility; not a subject case or model run','source_changes':['src/shiv/cli.py: long option rename with callback parameter retained','src/shiv/constants.py: current error message'],'results':results,'model_calls':0},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
